column1: # Synonyms of the English files: kind, the English word that an English file may use, the Latin word of the JSON (the name that the Russian file gets from the dictionary).
# They are read when the file is in English only. The English sample of the methodology (state-machine-agent-step.en.portolan.md) names two things otherwise than the dictionary of the
# methodology (version 9) and the product do, and the tree `machine/2` of the product (the scenarios, the interpreter) keeps the names of the dictionary:
#   transport_usage: the field of the variants of TurnResult (the dictionary calls the field `usage`, the datum `transport_usage` is another thing);
#   elevated_attention_executor: the project setting that makes the gatekeeper a human or an agent (the product names it `attention_executor`).
